notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block Charnelhoard Wurm.
description:
Cast Sozin's Comet by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Declare Charnelhoard Wurm as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Great Train Heist by paying {2}{R}{R}, selecting its first mode, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Charnelhoard Wurm, triggering its ability, returning Great Train Heist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
